decisionRule.reference: first linked experiment = the post-plan repeat-0 reference

dataUse.note: class-holdout nested CV inside the training folds only; no external holdout used

scopeNote: EXP-0127 reference; two executed frozen seed blocks (repeat 0/1); constraint-satisfaction excluded from the decision

supplementarySeedBlock.note: repeat-2 frozen seed block executed AFTER the plan was registered; NOT part of the ROB-0016 execution set and not merged into its values/spread/decision

constructionNote: constraint-satisfaction = 1.000 in every run is a CONSTRUCTION property of the constrained projection, not evidence of distribution quality; the decision uses energy-distance only, and the un-normalised V / signed U are reported alongside it
limitations: generation and transfer must not be merged into one Q3 success rate
the executed plan has TWO linked blocks (repeat 0/1); the repeat-2 block was run after registration and is reported separately, not merged
the ledger records the method as param-perturbation (the perturbed object is the frozen seed block); it is NOT a multiple-seeds plan and there is no parameter/budget perturbation
energy-distance is a distributional discrepancy, not a scientific validity proof
the sensory t2n proxy still increases on part of the generated rows while the real chemical trans-2-nonenal never increases; the two are different propositions
